checks.name: pause_active_worker_at_committed_checkpoint
checks.result: The JobService executor thread was held immediately after step 1 committed. Pausing the task and cancelling its job, then releasing the thread, left the task paused with no step-2 start or success audit.

checks.name: resume_active_worker_from_checkpoint
checks.result: After the paused worker exited, rescheduling completed step 2 from the same checkpoint. The capability invocation and step-1 checkpoint each remained at one; step 2 saved once.

checks.name: cancel_active_worker_at_committed_checkpoint
checks.result: The JobService executor thread was held immediately after step 1 committed. Cancelling the task and its job, then releasing the thread, left the task cancelled with no step-2 start, result, success audit, or pending job.

checks.name: pending_job_pause_resume_cancel_regression
checks.result: The same run repeated the prior pending-job cases: pause preserved the checkpoint, resume did not repeat the capability call, and cancellation removed the scheduled job.

scopeLimit: The worker was gated after the step-1 checkpoint transaction committed and before step 2 began. Interruption inside a provider call or a database transaction remains untested.
